items.text:
Happy Election Day. I hope you'll exercise your right to vote in our country and make your voice heard. 

I am praying for our state and our country while believing that our best days are yet to come. Find your polling location at https://t.co/KuKl0IfhuR. https://t.co/QAzPX9RWsv

Kansas Hospital Association supports hospitals across Kansas. We discussed the importance of policies that support 340B, the Rural Emergency Hospital program, and Critical Access Hospitals.
Thank you @kansashospitals for your commitment to Kansans and the health care community! https://t.co/YAMGCgNGqA

Too often, red tape and processing delays prevent qualified healthcare providers from serving patients in rural communities like those in the Big First.

I introduced the States Handling Access to Reciprocity for Employment (SHARE) Act, a bipartisan bill that will help address workforce shortages in rural health care by streamlining the licensure process for medical professionals.

https://t.co/4M90qJcZFO

I had great meetings with @NAMAmillers, @CIRBdc, and @AAVMC.

We talked about the importance of strengthening food aid, protecting the Federal Crop Insurance Program, and keeping rural vets in communities that feed, clothe, and fuel the world. Thanks for stopping by! https://t.co/IY3vPXhq0Q

I had productive conversations with @Cargill, Land O’Lakes, and @BigIofKansas about the future of agriculture in the Big First.

We talked about workforce shortages, tax policy, the Farm Bill, and crop insurance — all essential to helping Kansas producers feed, fuel, and clothe the world. Thanks for stopping by!

I had productive conversations with @kansashospitals, @ASLRRA, and @GAManufacturers.

We discussed the importance of strong rural hospitals, the critical role short line railroads play in connecting Kansas producers to markets, and the need to strengthen American aviation manufacturing. Thank you to these groups for the work they do to keep our state at the forefront of innovation.

Farmers and ranchers in the Big First need certainty, not more red tape.

The @HouseAgGOP budget bill invests in crop insurance, updates reference prices, and strengthens export promotion programs.

It’s a real step forward for agriculture and food security in Kansas and across rural America.

Community banks are essential partners for rural communities across the Big First. I met with Kansans from @ICBA to discuss the need for a five-year Farm Bill that expands the farm safety net, increases USDA loan limits, and strengthens crop insurance. Thanks for all you do for our communities!

After Congressional Democrats held a Farm Bill hostage last Congress, @HouseAgGOP fought to address some of the agriculture community’s most pressing needs. 

Our One Big Beautiful Bill delivers wins for Kansas agricultural producers by expanding crop insurance, updating reference prices, bolstering trade promotion programs, and funding ag research.

The One Big Beautiful Bill delivers wins for the Big First:

➡️Invests $60 billion in the farm safety net
➡️Strengthens Medicaid for the most vulnerable populations
➡️Extends the largest tax cuts in history
➡️Codifies @POTUS’ executive orders that strengthen our southern border

I was proud to support the agenda that 77 million Americans voted for in November.

Our One Big Beautiful Bill strengthens Medicaid coverage and SNAP benefits for America’s most vulnerable populations, like pregnant women, seniors, individuals with disabilities, and single moms with kids too young to attend school.

Every dollar from these programs sent to people who are in the country illegally or to able-bodied adults unwilling to join the workforce is a dollar taken from those who need it the most.

Rural hospitals like Wamego Health Center are essential to keeping Kansas communities strong and healthy. I had a great visit with their team to discuss how Congress can support the essential services rural hospitals provide to communities across the Big First. 

I’m grateful for the dedicated health care professionals who show up every day to care for their neighbors. Thank you for all you do.

Too many families in the Big First and across the country have been affected by addiction, mental health struggles, and the fentanyl crisis. That’s why I voted to pass the SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Reauthorization Act.

This bill will make sure Kansans get the help they need by investing in treatment and recovery resources, supporting mental and behavioral health training, and helping first responders save lives.

I am proud of @HouseGOP’s work to strengthen our nation’s safety net and protect the integrity of Americans’ tax dollars. Programs like SNAP and Medicaid were intended for our most vulnerable populations, not for able-bodied adults without dependents who simply don’t want to work.

Requiring 20 hours a week of work or volunteering for able–bodied individuals to receive these benefits should not be controversial.

Our agricultural community needs a five-year Farm Bill that is long enough to provide certainty and short enough to respond to the times. 

While my @HouseAgGOP colleagues and I delivered for farmers in the OBBBA by updating reference prices, expanding crop insurance, and overhauling the radical death tax, we still need to pass a five-year, comprehensive farm bill for our producers.

The Big Beautiful Bill is a win for farmers, ranchers, and rural communities:

➡️Increases and permanently extends the Small Business Deduction
➡️Strengthens the farm safety net
➡️Expands crop insurance
➡️Protects two million family farms from the death tax

The One Big Beautiful Bill made historic investments in rural America by updating reference prices, expanding crop insurance, and cutting taxes on family farms.

But Kansas producers still need a five-year, fiscally conservative Farm Bill that keeps American agriculture competitive.

Our One Big Beautiful Bill delivers for Kansas farmers, ranchers, and rural communities:

➡️Increases and permanently extends the Small Business Deduction
➡️Expands crop insurance
➡️Strengthens the farm safety net
➡️Protects two million family farms from the death tax

The One Big Beautiful Bill delivered for Kansas agriculture: stronger crop insurance, higher reference prices, more trade promotion funding, and key investments in animal health research.

More on how @HouseAgGOP is supporting farmers:
https://t.co/uujXCQ1EeM

Rural health care and conservation are both essential for the Big First’s way of life. I stopped by Rice County District Hospital and met with the Rice County Conservation District in Lyons to discuss improving access to care and preserving the land we rely on. Thanks for meeting with me!

The One Big Beautiful Bill delivers real wins for Kansas agriculture:

➡️ Expanded crop insurance
➡️ Updated reference prices
➡️ Decreased taxes on family farms 

But now we must pass a full Farm Bill that provides further certainty and includes the many “orphan programs” our producers count on to feed, fuel, and clothe the world.

The One Big Beautiful Bill invests in the future of agriculture by lowering taxes for producers and strengthening the farm safety net.

We still must pass a comprehensive, five-year Farm Bill that provides certainty for our producers, further invests in animal health research, and addresses the issues of today, not 2018.

Access to quality health care is vital to our rural communities. I visited SunPorch in Smith Center—where I met Blondina Kuhlmann, who just celebrated her 100th birthday—and toured Graham County Hospital in Hill City to learn more about how providers are caring for Kansans across the Big First. Thank you for the meetings!

The Chinese Communist Party’s treatment of the Uyghur people is a grave violation of human rights.

The House passed the Uyghur Policy Act to stand with oppressed minority communities in China and ensure the United States leads with moral clarity on the world stage.

Rural America trusted @POTUS and @HouseGOP to provide relief, & that’s just what we did. We put Kansas agriculture first by:

➡️Updating reference prices to reflect today’s ag economy
➡️Strengthening crop insurance for our farmers
➡️Doubling investments in trade promotion programs like MAP and FMD

These commonsense wins give Kansas farmers and ag producers the certainty they need to continue feeding, fueling, and clothing the world.
